# Sancho Godinho

> Sancho Godinho is a software developer, cybersecurity researcher, DevOps and infrastructure enthusiast, and open-source contributor based in Mumbai, India. This is his personal portfolio: https://sancho.sg-app.com

Last updated: 2026-11-20

## About

Sancho Godinho builds web applications, developer tools, CLIs, bots, and infrastructure. His work combines software development with security research. He has found and responsibly reported vulnerabilities affecting organizations including Amazon, LemonSqueezy, Dodo Payments, Crazy Games, Smash Karts, and Codesphere. He is currently open to software development, open-source, developer tooling, and technology roles in Mumbai or remote.

## Professional experience

- **Community Manager & Open Source Software Developer**, Dodo Payments (October 2025 – October 2026, remote; past role). Managed the Dodo Payments Discord community, provided technical support, and was a core maintainer of the Dodo Payments CLI, Discord bot, migration tool, and sync engine. Assisted developers with technical integrations and contributed to open-source maintenance.

## Technical expertise

Bun, Node.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, React Native, Expo, Python, Bash, MongoDB, Docker, Socket.io, Tailscale, Linux, server management, infrastructure optimization, server security, UFW, REST APIs, WebSockets, Git, and DevOps. Web security, vulnerability research, penetration testing, and responsible disclosure.

- [Tiles Game](https://sancho.sg-app.com/project/Tiles%20Game): A simple browser game: https://sg-app.com/Tiles-Game/

- [Clokie](https://sancho.sg-app.com/project/Clokie): A customizable clock for display: https://sancho1952007.github.io/Clokie/

## Open-source contributions

Sancho Godinho is an active open-source contributor. He was a core maintainer at Dodo Payments for the CLI, Discord bot, migration tool, and sync engine, and has contributed to projects including Dokploy, Elysia.js, and Umami. The most complete index is his GitHub profile: https://github.com/sancho1952007

Selected public repositories:

- s0, subdomain finder: https://github.com/sancho1952007/s0
- Bunserv, static file server built with Bun: https://github.com/sancho1952007/bunserv
- Modern GUI, Tkinter window replacement: https://github.com/sancho1952007/Modern-GUI-v3.0
- Dodo Payments CLI: https://github.com/dodopayments/dodopayments-cli
- Dodo Payments migration tool: https://github.com/dodopayments/dodo-migrate
- Dodo Payments sync engine: https://github.com/dodopayments/dodo-sync

## Security research

Sancho Godinho performs responsible vulnerability research and reporting. Organizations whose products he has reported vulnerabilities in include Amazon, LemonSqueezy, Dodo Payments, Crazy Games, Smash Karts, and Codesphere. No CVE identifiers, severity ratings, bounties, or formal acknowledgements are claimed on this site.
